definitions.explanation: A prefecture in central Kyushu and its capital city. Known for Kumamoto Castle, the Aso volcano, and the black bear mascot くまモン.

examples.japanese: {熊本|くまもと}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{九州|きゅうしゅう}→九州：15647_kyuushuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
{熊本城|くまもとじょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧{三名城|さんめいじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{数|かぞ}えられる→数える：01926_kazoeru⟧。
examples.english: Kumamoto Castle is counted among Japan's three great castles.

examples.japanese: ２０１６⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{熊本|くまもと}{地震|じしん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{熊本城|くまもとじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{石垣|いしがき}→石垣：19673_ishigaki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{崩|くず}れた→崩れる：04248_kuzureru⟧。
examples.english: In the 2016 Kumamoto earthquakes, the stone walls of Kumamoto Castle partly collapsed.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {熊本県|くまもとけん}: Kumamoto Prefecture
- {熊本市|くまもとし}: Kumamoto City
- {熊本城|くまもとじょう}: Kumamoto Castle
- {熊本|くまもと}{地震|じしん}: the Kumamoto earthquakes (April 2016)

CULTURAL NOTE:
The old province here was {肥後|ひご}. The prefecture is home to {阿蘇山|あそさん}, one of the world's largest calderas, and to くまモン, a prefectural mascot known throughout Japan. Local foods include ⟦{馬刺|ばさ}し→馬刺し：30436_basashi⟧ (raw horse meat) and {辛子|からし}れんこん.
